{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the unique values in key columns
print("Arms:", df['arm'].unique())
print("Severity levels:", df['severity'].unique())
print("Response values:", df['responded'].unique())

# Check for duplicates
print("Number of duplicate rows:", df.duplicated().sum())

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values per column:", df.isnull().sum())

# Summary of the 'responded' column
print("Response rate overall:", df['responded'].mean())"}
